description: This file defines interfaces for an IPC server and client within the Rialto project, including classes IClient and IServer, with methods for managing client connections, sending messages, and integrating with external event loops. It uses Google Protocol Buffers for message serialization.

classes.name: IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a connected client, providing methods to query client info, send events, and manage connection state.

classes.name: IServer
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC server, providing methods to manage socket connections, create clients, and process I/O events.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Creates a listening socket for incoming client connections, optionally with callbacks for connection events.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Creates a new client object from a socket file descriptor, with optional disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns an external file descriptor for event loop integration.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout, blocking until events occur or timeout expires.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming connections and data, handling server I/O.
